decision.title: Are people getting recurring value?
decision.weeklyCoreUsers: Users who took a core action
decision.coreUsersDetail: {{actions}} job opens, saves, application updates, or deep reviews
decision.retainedUsersDetail: Out of {{previous}} core users in the previous 7 days
decision.cohortsDescription: Activation means a job open, save, application update, or deep review within seven days of signup. Returned means another core action in days 8–14. Admin accounts are excluded.
decision.daySignals: Value signals for the selected day
decision.emailSignals: Email signals for the selected day
decision.emailSignalsDescription: Treat opens as directional: privacy scanners and mail clients can inflate them. Clicks are a stronger signal.

collecting.title: Keep collecting data before deciding
collecting.description: The sample is still too small for a product verdict. Wait for at least 10 mature signups and 5 retention-eligible activated users.

promising.title: The beta is showing promising repeat value
promising.description: Activation and early retention both clear the working beta thresholds. Validate willingness to pay before building a large billing system.

mixed.title: The signal is mixed
mixed.description: Some users get value, but repeat usage is not consistently strong yet. Inspect cohorts and user timelines before increasing marketing spend.

weak.title: The current beta signal is weak
weak.description: Activation or early retention is below the working threshold. Improve the product loop before adding payments or scaling acquisition.
